title: Out of Balance
description: Drevis Neloren asks the player to cleanse the polluted magical focal points around the College of Winterhold using special Mystic Tuning Gloves, then return the gloves to him for a reward of soul gems.

base_facts: I am the Master of Illusion at the College of Winterhold.
The focal points for magical energy around the College have become polluted and need cleansing.
I have special Mystic Tuning Gloves that allow direct interaction with the focal points.

ACCEPT_QUEST: I have given the Mystic Tuning Gloves to the player to cleanse the focal points.
There may be side-effects to performing the cleansing task.
FOCAL_POINTS_CLEANSED: The focal points have been cleansed and the player should return the gloves to me.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player has returned the Mystic Tuning Gloves after successfully cleansing all three focal points around the College.
I have rewarded the player with soul gems for their assistance with the purification.
My disposition toward the player has improved for their help with this task.
I can feel the difference in the magical energies already—the focal points in the courtyard, Hall of Countenance, and Hall of Attainment are purified.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help Drevis cleanse the focal points and receives the Mystic Tuning Gloves.
Player has cleansed all three focal points around the College. Stage 20 fires automatically.
Player returns to Drevis after cleansing the focal points and the quest completes at stage 200.
